openItems.explanation: Northline Crane Supply agreement NCS-RA-2291 rents HGC a crawler crane for 36 months from September 1, 2025 at $18,500.00 a month, which HGC may not end early. It is a lease, not short-term, and an operating lease by the five tests. It is expensed as a rental and missing from the lease schedule. Proposed: record a right-of-use asset and a lease liability of $448,826.56 at June 30, 2026 ($199,035.79 current, $249,790.77 long-term), discounted at the policy’s 6.75%. Income is unaffected. The machine never posts.

The office lease was extended 60 months from January 1, 2026 on December 12, 2025. It is an operating lease and must be recognized; the controller only discloses it, at a flat $19,500.00.
